_comment: Optional manual fixes for movies TMDB gets wrong. Point at this file with 'tmdb_overrides_file' in your config, then run: media-agent tmdb-fix
_corrections: Exact filename (as it appears on disk) -> the correct TMDB id. Find the id in the TMDB page URL: themoviedb.org/movie/8009-highlander -> 8009. Use this when the lookup confidently picked the WRONG film.
_misspellings: Fix typos in your filenames before searching. Lowercase fragment -> replacement. Use this when a lookup finds nothing because the filename is misspelled.
